lesson.grammar_point: verb to be in the present (am, is, are)

listenings.text: Good morning. This is Camille. I am at the front desk. Sorry, my name is not easy. Again: Camille. Your car is here. It is at nine. The driver is Paul. He is a tall man. His jacket is blue. He is very nice. I am here all day. Thank you, and have a good morning.

Hello, everybody. My name is Daniel. I am from Mexico. I am very happy to be here tonight. I am not a big talker, so this is short. I am here for work. My company is small. We are nine people, and I am the owner. My English is not perfect. Please, slowly. Thank you. Nice to meet you.

extra_audio.text: Good morning. My name is Leao. I am from Brazil. I work for a company in Sao Paulo. Nice to meet you. And you? What is your name?
